verdict.rationale: The evidence has nothing on a new-hire self-onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, or bank details. The 'onboarding' mentions refer to setting up the employer's own Paychex Flex account. Employee self-service is cited only for fixing missing punches and reviewing paychecks, and the Worker API and employee-data use cases are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send a new hire a self-serve onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one
